title: 3DAIStudio : Unethical Business Practice & Reddit Bullying
author: South-Biscotti-9744
selftext:
Yesterday I paid USD $16.99 for [3DAISTUDIO ](https://www.3daistudio.com)to try their Image to 3D generator. It quickly went pear shaped (literally and metaphorically).  
I posted the screenshots of the failed Image to 3D generation to their Discord, which their Dev emphatically promotes on reddit as proof it is not a scam. They deleted me from their Discord channel over light.

The Dev u/Overall-Cry9838 has posted repeatedly on reddit threads using bullying language like "Nobody forced you to use it"

Well, if it's free or open source then sure. But it you advertise and bully people online telling them your product works... and you took money for it. Then yeah you are responsible for delivering what you promised.

Link to [thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1f7fgo9/is_3daistudiocom_fake_or_real/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button) where Jan aka u/Overall-Cry9838 who also mods the Discord server defended the fake features of 3DAIstudio.
